messages.author: 39635dc79582ca29
messages.subject: ReportingTools not displaying images
parts:
Hello guys I am trying to get reportingTools to work with DeSeq and R Shiny. The whole idea is to write a shiny app using the code example given by reportingTools here for DeSeq . ReportingTools makes some suggestions code in order to work with shiny also here . with this knowledge i came out with my server.r and ui.r codes below:


ui.R

library(ReportingTools)
library(shiny)


shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  custHeaderPanel("ReportingTools", 
                  js = list.files(system.file("extdata/jslib", package="ReportingTools"),
                                  full.names=TRUE),
                  css = list.files(system.file("extdata/csslib", package="ReportingTools"),
                                   pattern="bootstrap.css", full.names=TRUE),
  ),
  
  sidebarPanel(
    
  ),
  
  
 
  mainPanel(
   
    htmlOutput("view2")
  )
))

and 

server.R


library(ReportingTools)
library(shiny)
library(DESeq)



##custom rendering function for server.R
renderRepTools = function(expr, env=parent.frame(), quoted=FALSE) {
  func <- exprToFunction(expr, env, quoted)
  function(){
    paste(capture.output(func()), collapse="\n")
  }
}


##open the report with the shinyHandlers
htmlrep = HTMLReport(reportDirectory = "./",shortName="bigtest", handlers = shinyHandlers)




shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  data(mockRnaSeqData)
  cds<-newCountDataSet(mockRnaSeqData, conditions)
  cds<-estimateSizeFactors(cds)
  cds<-estimateDispersions(cds)
  res<-nbinomTest(cds,"control", "case" )
 
  
  ###use RT to display output
  output$view2 <- renderRepTools({
    publish(res,htmlrep,name="df",countTable=mockRnaSeqData, pvalueCutoff=0.05,conditions=conditions,annotation.db="org.Mm.eg.db",
            expName="deseq",reportDir="./", .modifyDF=makeDESeqDF)
  })
})

This seems to slowly generate a reportingTool table after about 2 minutes of waiting after running the code however even though the images seems to be available in the report directory they fail to show up?

Anyone knows why this is so or yet still a better idea of how to get R shiny to display this code for DeSEq from the manual here ?
